currentContext.expansion: The Company intends to keep expanding its southern India retail footprint, which grew from 53 stores as on March 31, 2024 to 61 stores in 51 cities as on March 31, 2026 (8 Large Format, 43 Medium Format, 10 Small Format; 650,881 sq. ft. total operational area). From the Net Proceeds of the Fresh Issue it proposes to set up 10 New Stores - 5 in Fiscal 2027 and 5 in Fiscal 2028 - all company-operated, in a mix of Large, Medium and Small formats, with an assumed average store size of 11,000 sq. ft.
